panels.headline: From Dream to Doctor
panels.body: For every late night, long shift, and quiet sacrifice that brought you here.
panels.art_direction: Front cover design: a premium, elegant, white-coat-wearing figure stands proudly in front of a soft-gold-embossed medical-school background with a stethoscope draped over their shoulder. The white coat and stethoscope are in deep navy. The panel headline and body fit within a clean text-safe area at the top and bottom of the panel. The deep navy, white, and soft gold colors are used throughout the design.

panels.headline: Years In The Making
panels.body: You kept going through exams, late nights, long shifts, and the sacrifices most people never saw. Today honors the discipline behind the white coat as much as the degree itself.

The family is proud of his discipline, patience, heart, and dedication.
